description.value: Prestige Hotel Kamloops is an 87-room modern hotel in Kamloops' Aberdeen neighbourhood, part of a BC family-owned chain of 19 properties. Guests have access to an indoor pool, waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre, and on-site dining at restaurant Isagani. Its location near Sun Peaks Resort and surrounding hills makes it a practical base for cyclists exploring the Thompson Plateau region.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms the hotel is open and operating, with a detailed amenities list on the overview page. Wi-Fi is explicitly listed as 'Complimentary High Speed Wi-Fi' in the hotel features. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, or other cycling-specific amenities anywhere in the fetched pages. Contact details (phone, address) on the website's contact subpage match OSM exactly.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, publicly accessible hotel with an active website and confirmed contact details. A practical overnight stop for touring cyclists in Kamloops.

wow_evidence: BC family-owned chain of 19 properties; indoor pool, waterslide, hot tub, fitness centre
